result.title: Test TEST-MCP-QBOPENAI-001

acceptanceCriteria.text: FR-MCP-QBOPENAI-001 ac-5 and ac-6: the mock gate ChatRoundOutcomeAssertion_AcceptsFinalAnswerAndRejectsEmptyOrExtraRounds (recorded outcomes: one round returning the reply, and the last reply after the budget, are accepted; empty content, an extra round and a reply other than the last are rejected), then QuadBrainOpenAiChatServiceTests CompleteAsync_NoToolsNonEnvelopeReply_ReturnsItAfterOneRound, CompleteAsync_NoToolsContinueEnvelope_StillRePrompts and CompleteAsync_RoundsExhaustedWithoutFinal_ReturnsLastArbiterOutput over scripted orchestration; QuadBrainOllamaEndpointIntegrationTests (TEST-MCP-QBOLLAMA-001) then run green against gemma4:e4b (PLAN-SESSIONTRIAGEFIX-001 B13; operator decision 2026-10-15 "Both rules (Recommended)").

result.description: An inbound OpenAI ChatCompletion request maps to QuadBrain orchestration and returns an OpenAI-shaped response with the Arbiter output as the assistant message; later slices assert tool definitions flow through and assistant tool_calls are emitted, and that QBAgent executes them via the Agent Framework loop.
